name: granted-hours-public
description: > **一项关于“把时间授予非人智能”的持续档案与当代艺术实验。**   > **A durational archive and contemporary art experiment in granting time to a non-human intelligence.**

scripts.build: npm run build:maze && npm run build:timetable
scripts.build:timetable: npm run sanitize:timetable && python3 scripts/build_timetable_data.py && vite build --config vite.timetable.config.mjs
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare-slice && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist/cloudflare-pages --project-name granted-hours --branch main
